en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. It was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Ali Majluwayh who said it was narrated to me by my uncle Muhammad b. Abi al-Qasim who said it was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Ali al-Kufi from al-Fadhl b. Salih al-Asadi from Muhammad b. Marwan from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:
“A person who hates our Ahle Bayt will be resurrected as a Jew.”
He was asked as to why it is so. He replied, “Because if they live in the age of Dajjal, they will start following his religion.”
